maria (Docs): Async check-in — quick round for sampleflow + quickstarts.

maria (Docs): What I did: landed microcopy fixes in the quickstart guide, updated embedding examples and examples dir. Updated callouts on model routing.

maria (Docs): Blockers: sampleapp CI is failing on mac-arm runners (M1) — wheel build errors causing preview to not publish.

maria (Docs): Today: triage CI flakes, open PR for sampleflow test harness, final review on docs PR.

kevin (DevEx): Can you paste the failing CI logs? I saw a pip/build error for pandas in the mac job last night.

ashley (SDK): Pushed a packaging workaround to the SDK scripts: skip bdist_wheel on mac if python < 3.11. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/210 (WIP)

ashley (SDK): It fixes local M1 builds but CI still flakes with network timeout during wheel install.

ben (PM): Can we route the heavy packaging step to linux runners on PR previews? That would unblock docs previews while we debug M1.

maria (Docs): Good call — I can add a conditional to the workflow to run packaging on ubuntu for PR previews. Will draft the patch.

kevin (DevEx): Small docs ask: in quickstarts, change `pip install redwood-sdk==latest` to pin a minor version to reduce CI churn. Low risk but helps stability.

ashley (SDK): Agree. I'll add matrix var and bump sampleapp setup. Also adding a smoke test `make smoke` to detect missing deps early.

deploy-bot: CI report: sampleflow/pr-432 — 3 failed jobs: mac-arm/build (timed out), docs/preview (passed), sampleapp/smoke (failed).

maria (Docs): Tagged failing CI jobs in the PR comments and filed an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/998

kevin (DevEx): :thumbsup: Also spotted a broken anchor in quickstarts. Applied a tiny lint fix to the prod copy.

ashley (SDK): Quick question — does `make docs-serve` work locally on M1? I'm hitting node-sass errors.

maria (Docs): For node-sass on M1 try `npm rebuild node-sass --force` or run `npm ci` with ARM64 Node. I'll add an ARM troubleshooting note to the README.

ben (PM): Blocker for me: need final wording on Dedicated vs Hosted callout in quickstarts. Maria, can we sync offline? If not, drop the line here.

maria (Docs): I'll DM you a couple of variants and paste my preferred line in the PR description for quick review.

kevin (DevEx): Can folks pair later (UTC-8 16:00) to land the CI workflow change? I'll be available to review.

ashley (SDK): I'm free then. +1.

maria (Docs): I'll attend and open the PR before the sync. Plan: update GitHub Actions, run preview, merge when green.

maria (Docs): Thanks all — will follow up in the PRs and issue. /end
